narration: Heavy hydrogen is the fingerprint. The ratio of heavy to normal hydrogen in water would help tell comets, asteroids and the Sun apart.
visual_brief: The ROSINA mass spectrometer instrument on Rosetta, which measured this ratio at a comet.

candidates.title: Electronics for a Spectrometer
candidates.description: NASA has provided part of the electronics package for an instrument called the Double Focusing Mass Spectrometer, which is part of the Swiss-built Rosetta Orbiter Spectrometer for Ion and Neutral Analysis ROSINA instrument.
